title: fix(cloud): rent cost-trap + teardown-strand hardening (ING #34 A/B/C) — --search-only dry-run, unknown-flag refuse, cross-project kill escape
body: ROOT CAUSE (LIVE cost incident 2026-07-01: an accidental real rental cost money). Two cost-safety gaps in the hexa cloud CLI (stdlib/cloud/cloud_cli.hexa + stdlib/cloud/vast.hexa). (A) COST-TRAP: `cloud rent <provider>` had NO way to LIST offers without provisioning a billable pod — verifying 'do offers exist?' cost a real rental; worse, an unrecognized `--dry-run` was SILENTLY IGNORED, the search picked an offer ($0.43/hr) and CREATED an instance. FIX A: added `--search-only` (alias `--dry-run`) to `cloud rent` — vast lists matching offers (id/$per-hr/gpu/specs via new vast_list_offers, same query a real rent uses) and EXITS renting nothing; runpod reports the --gpu selector (no marketplace). AND a rent-verb UNKNOWN-FLAG guard (_rent_flag_arity/_rent_unknown_flag) now REFUSES any unrecognized flag on the one $-incurring verb (exit 2, no provider call) instead of silently dropping it — reference-match: strict arg parsers / terraform --dry-run. (B) `cloud rm/down vast <id>` mis-ordered the provider into the id slot ('vast' parsed AS the id -> silent no-op leaving a billing pod alive); now errors with the correct usage (`cloud rm <id> --provider vast`). (C) TEARDOWN-STRAND: the cross-project kill-guard refused `rm/down --force` on a pod attributed to another project, so a cost-leaking pod unreachable from its owner repo was UN-KILLABLE via the sanctioned CLI (only raw `vastai destroy` + `cloud forget` worked). FIX C: added an EXPLICIT `--yes-cross-project` escape (threaded into _down_guard_refuses as override_xproj) — never implied by --force alone (preserves convergence CLOUD-CROSSPROJECT-FORCE: a mis-parsed auto --force must not cross projects), and the refusal message now names all 3 escapes incl. `cloud forget` for registry-only cleanup when the pod is already gone (forget is already guard-free). Tests: down_guard_project_test extended with the +xproj escape cases; new rent_search_only_flag_test (pure mirror) for the unknown-flag guard. byteeq-NEUTRAL: self/ references cloud_cli.hexa only as a dispatched-script STRING (no `use`), vast.hexa has no self/ import, and NO new verb touches cloud_commands() (the byteeq-relevant roster) — so gen3=gen4 fixpoint is unchanged. GATE: PR CI (Blacksmith 3-target selfhost byteeq expected byte-eq reconverge + ship smoke GREEN) before merge. Build/test on aiden/summer pool (mini=git/gh only).
